title: Eastern-Style Kibbeh Cakes with Crisp Fish
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired dish featuring crispy kibbeh cakes topped with pan-seared fish and served with a side of oceanic slaw.

ingredients.name: oceanic slaw mix
ingredients.notes: or make your own with shredded cabbage, mayonnaise, and lemon juice

ingredients.name: middle eastern spice blend
ingredients.notes: such as sumac, cumin, and paprika

instructions: Prepare kibbeh according to package instructions or recipe.
Cut fish fillets into 4 equal pieces.
Season fish with middle eastern spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add fish to skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer fish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add a small amount of olive oil to the skillet and fry kibbeh cakes until crispy and golden brown.
Serve kibbeh cakes topped with pan-seared fish and a side of oceanic slaw.
Garnish with crisp lettuce and a squeeze of lemon juice.
